brief: A personal, localhost-only Docker server that exposes a Google AI Pro subscription as an OpenAI-compatible API and an MCP server, in one process. Precise, small and honest about its limits.
criteria: Recognisable at 16 px, works in one colour, and says one thing: two inputs, one queue, one output.

concepts.name: Funnel
concepts.idea: Two inputs, the API and the MCP server, merge into one output: the single queue in front of the agy CLI.
rationale: The cyan output is the one thing that runs at a time
Two strokes in, one stroke out: readable at 16 px and in one colour
Built on the two bars of the landing page mark, now joined
